metadata.title: 中华人民共和国药品管理法 (Drug Administration Law of the Peoples Republic of China, 2019 revision, Chinese original)
metadata.edition: 2019 revision (second revision), adopted 26 Aug 2019, in force 1 Dec 2019 · Chapter VII Arts. 77, 80 to 83; Arts. 19 and 155 · copy published by the National Center for ADR Monitoring
metadata.legal_basis: Drug Administration Law of the Peoples Republic of China · Chapter VII Arts. 77, 80 to 83 as in force; the official text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
